pack.deleted: Deleted pack {name}. Its stickers remain in your library.
pack.removed: Removed the sticker from {name}. It remains in your library.
pack.duplicate: Already in your library; added to {name}.
toimage.staticGif: This sticker is not animated, so I sent a PNG.
errors.internal: Something went wrong with the sticker.
errors.noMedia: Send or reply to an image, GIF, video or sticker.
errors.unsupportedType: That file type can't be made into a sticker. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or MP4/WebM video.
errors.tooManyFrames: The animation has too many frames (limit {limitFrames}).
errors.dimensionsTooLarge: The image is too large (limit {limit} px per side).
errors.corrupt: The file is damaged or incomplete, so it can't be read.
errors.conversionFailed: The sticker could not be created from this file.
errors.outputTooLarge: Even at the lowest quality the sticker is over WhatsApp's size limit. Try a shorter or simpler clip.
errors.encoderMissing: This Levix build can't encode stickers (its FFmpeg has no WebP encoder). Update Levix.
errors.timeout: The conversion took too long and was stopped.
errors.busy: Levix is converting other stickers right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.notFound: That sticker is not in your library.
errors.invalidName: Pack names are 1–40 characters: letters, digits, spaces, - _ ' . & , or emoji, and can't be a command word.
errors.invalidOptions: Those sticker options are not valid.
errors.libraryFull: Your sticker library is full ({limit} stickers). Delete some first.
errors.packLimit: You can have at most {limit} packs.
errors.inUse: This sticker is in one or more packs. Confirm to delete it everywhere.
errors.storageUnavailable: The sticker library can't be written right now.
errors.notConnected: WhatsApp is not connected, so nothing can be sent.

errors.videoTooLong.one: The video is too long (limit {n} seconds). Send a shorter clip, or trim it in the panel's Sticker Studio.
errors.videoTooLong.other: The video is too long (limit {n} seconds). Send a shorter clip, or trim it in the panel's Sticker Studio.

hint.name: <name>
packs.empty: No packs yet. Reply to media with {hint} to start one. Library: {count}.
stickers.empty: No stickers here yet. Reply to media with {sticker} or {pack} to save one.
pack.needName: Use {add} while replying to media, or {create}.
toimage.firstFrame: First frame of an animated sticker. Use {hint} for the animation.
